message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Unpacker", "method": "process", "explanation": "The attacker-controlled ZIP entry name from zipEntry.getName() is mapped and used in `new File(outputDir, name)`. The only containment check is `name.indexOf(\"..\") != -1 && !file.getCanonicalPath().startsWith(outputDir.getCanonicalPath())`, which is inadequate because it does not require a path-separator boundary after the output directory. An entry such as `../analysis-output2/evil` can resolve outside `outputDir` while still satisfying the startsWith prefix check, allowing the tainted File path to flow to `FileUtils.copy(in, file)` and ultimately to a configured FileOutputStream sink."}]}
